Adaptive snapshot verification: reruns the mass-window observable up to max_iterations separate hardware jobs, adjusting shot budget each round. Stops early only when |estimate − target| ≤ epsilon; otherwise runs all iterations to build pathway training data.
Policy-adaptive verification: learns historical bias and chooses multi-knob actions (shots, bins, symmetry, backend) each iteration. Stops based on epsilon and cost-vs-expected-gain economics.
